## Featured Projects & Benchmarks
- **Telco Customer Churn MLOps Platform**: Production-ready MLOps system featuring **0.847 ROC-AUC**, recall improved from **48% → 80%** through threshold tuning, automated CI/CD, MLflow experiment tracking, Docker/Kubernetes deployment, and drift-aware retraining.
- **TN Government AI Scheme Assistant (TNGov-AI-Assistant)**: Bilingual (English/Tamil) RAG assistant for citizen welfare scheme discovery achieving **86/86 validation tests passed** and **100% pass rate on a 50-query benchmark** using Groq LLaMA 3.3, ChromaDB, and FastAPI.
- **AI-Based Smart Garbage Segregation Bin**: Edge computer vision and IoT system delivering real-time **5-category waste classification** with sensor-based fallback logic using Arduino, ESP32-CAM, Flask, and TensorFlow.
- **Smart Child Nutrition Deficiency Tracking System**: Full-stack predictive analytics platform delivering **86.4% risk-classification accuracy**, **70% high-risk recall**, **92.69% mean accuracy across 7 deficiency predictions**, and 6-month nutrition trend forecasting.
